title: Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2018
ACT IV OF 2018
LAW AND JUSTICE COMMISSION OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Law and Justice
Commission
of Pakistan Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
3rd February, 2018]
No.
F. 9(31)/2017-Legis, dated 2.2.2018.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 31st January, 2018 and is hereby published for general information:--
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan
Ordinance, 1979 (XIV of 1979) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan (Amendment) Act,
2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

No.
F. 9(31)/2017-Legis, dated 2.2.2018.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 31st January, 2018 and is hereby published for general information:--
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan
Ordinance, 1979 (XIV of 1979) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment
of section 6B, Ordinance XIV of 1979.---In the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan Ordinance, 1979 (XIV of
1979), in section 6B, in clause (a),--
(a) After
the word "provinces", the words "and Islamabad Capital
Territory" shall be inserted;
(b) the
word "Provincial" shall be omitted; and
(c) for
the expression "Courts (s)", the word "Courts" shall be
substituted.
